title: Pass On The Recording Choice
description: Pass on the person's answer to this task's pending recording question when the person gave it to you in your own chat (they said to record the task as a workflow, or not to). Never answer it yourself or infer it from the task.
guidance: The DSphere sheet closes as if they had answered there; an answer they already gave there stands and is returned. Returns the settled choice, with create-workflow the recording wizard to use.

inputSchema.description: The task page, the pending question and the person's answer.

pageContextId.description: A page belonging to this task.

requestId.description: The pending question's requestId from recording or recording.state.

choice.description: create-workflow: the person wants the task recorded as a workflow. continue-without-recording: they do not.

outputSchema.description: The person's choice (in the sheet, or passed on with recording.choose) and the recording it started.

status.description: Wait while pending or starting; only recording and not-recording permit task actions. Failed means recording could not be started or its start was interrupted; stop and report it.

recordingActive.description: False after recording stops; further task page actions are refused.

keepWorkflow.description: False: collect once (wizard.run once true), never save.

wizardId.description: The standard guided recording wizard; finish, clean and save this draft.

wizardToken.description: Ownership token; keep it with the wizard id.
